name: WA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district (D+12 PVI) with long-serving incumbent Rick Larsen
Larsen's large fundraising advantage over a little-known challenger
Prediction markets price Larsen at roughly 97% to win
No public polling, so uncertainty rests on fundamentals alone
model.rationale: The district's D+12 lean, Larsen's incumbency and $2 million war chest against a minimally funded challenger, and markets pricing him near 97% all point to a comfortable Democratic hold. The forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin with modest tightening.
model.watch: Any late surge in spending or polling showing Feller within single digits would warrant revisiting, though no such evidence exists.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Larsen, a Democrat who has held this northwestern Washington seat for many years, faces Republican Edwin Feller in the general election. The district leans Democratic by about 12 points on the partisan lean index, and Larsen enters with roughly $2 million raised and a large cash advantage, while Feller has shown little fundraising activity. No outside groups are spending against the incumbent.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets price Larsen's chances near 97%. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with Larsen favored by roughly 20 points.
